content.prompt: Summarising Group 1 - complete the examiner's table (one short phrase per cell).

accepts: react with air to form oxide coatings

rows.label: Low melting points for metals, falling down the group

accepts: atoms get bigger so metallic bonding weakens
nuclei further from the delocalised electrons

rows.label: Compounds are white or colourless (unless the negative ion is coloured)

accepts: the M+ ion carries no colour
outer electron is lost more easily - further from the nucleus
less attraction between nucleus and outer electron
